App: Focus Timer Desk Clock Effective date: August 25, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how WBB ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, stores, and protects information when you use the Focus Timer Desk Clock application (the "App") on iOS or Android devices. We respect your privacy. Please read this policy carefully. If you do not agree with the relevant practices, stop using those features or uninstall the App.

This policy applies to processing carried out through the version of the App distributed on the Apple App Store and Google Play, and future updates, to the extent of features actually enabled on your device.
Depending on how you use the App and your device settings, the following types of information may be processed:

The App may store on your device information such as: Timer settings, durations, display options, and interface preferences Other app options you configure Cached data or session state needed for the App to function This data stays on your device. It is not sent to our servers — we do not operate a server for the App — unless we introduce sync or backend API features in the future and clearly disclose that in the App and in this Policy. See Data Retention and Deletion for how long it is kept and how to delete it.

The App records your completed and interrupted focus sessions so that it can show you reports, statistics, and charts about your own focus habits. This history is built up automatically as you use the App and may include: Start time, end time, and duration of each session Session type (for example focus, short break, long break) and whether it was completed or stopped early Counts and totals derived from the above (daily, weekly, and longer-term streaks, totals, and averages) Any optional label, task name, or note you choose to type yourself for a session This history is stored only in local storage on your own device. It is not uploaded to us, it is not shared with any third party, and it is not used for advertising, profiling, or any purpose other than displaying your own reports inside the App. We have no server and therefore no way to see it. Because a label or note is free text, please avoid typing information you would not want stored on your device — the App does not need it, and the statistics work without it. See Data Retention and Deletion for how long this history is kept and how to delete it.

When you buy a paid product or subscription in the App, Apple or Google processes payment and provides the App with transaction or entitlement status (for example which plan is active) through each store's mechanisms. We do not receive your full card number; payment details are handled by Apple/Google under their own policies.

When the App uses the network (if applicable), servers or third-party services may receive typical technical information, such as: Device type and operating system version Preferred language / locale Data needed to load content (for example images or animations) or call APIs Advertising identifiers: If the App does not integrate third-party advertising SDKs to track you for ads, we do not collect advertising identifiers for that purpose. If that changes, we will update this Policy and any required in-app or store disclosures.

The App may use device capabilities only when you grant permission and a feature actually needs them (for example motion/accelerometer for desk mode, screen brightness where the OS allows). note Store build configuration may declare additional permissions (for example camera, location, photo library). This Policy describes data collected through features actually in use. If the App does not use a declared permission, the publisher should update store permission disclosures to match reality and stay consistent with Apple App Privacy and Google Play Data safety.

We process information to: Provide and maintain timer, desk clock, and related features Generate your focus reports, statistics, and charts on your device, from the session history described in Section 3.2 Process paid products or subscriptions through Apple or Google Improve reliability, security, and experience (where necessary and lawful) Comply with legal obligations We do not sell your personal information.

Depending on your region, bases for processing may include: Performance of a contract or steps prior to it (providing the App and paid features) Legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention), balanced against your rights Your consent (for example enabling push notifications) Legal obligation

documents.t: We may share data with: Apple Inc. and Google LLC — IAP billing and app store operations They process data under their own privacy policies. We seek reasonable protections under contract or applicable service terms.

We do not operate any server or backend for the App, and we do not collect, store, or retain any user data on our systems. All data created by the App — your timer settings, durations, display options, interface preferences, and session state — is stored only in local storage on your own device. It is never uploaded to us, and we have no ability to access it.

Data Where it is stored How long it is retained Timer settings, durations, display and interface preferences Locally on your device only Until you delete it in the App, clear the App's data in your device settings, or uninstall the App. We retain no copy, and there is no retention period on our side. Focus session history and the statistics, reports, and charts derived from it (Section 3.2) Locally on your device only Retained on your device indefinitely, so that long-term reports and streaks stay available to you, until you delete it. We retain no copy, and there is no retention period on our side because the data never reaches us. Cached data and session state Locally on your device only Overwritten by the App as you use it, and removed entirely when you clear the App's data or uninstall the App. We retain no copy. In-app purchase / subscription records Held by Apple and Google, not by us Retained by Apple or Google under their own privacy policies. We only read the current entitlement status from the store at runtime and do not store it. Technical request data (device type, OS version, locale) sent when the App loads remote content, if applicable Transient, in the logs of the hosting or store provider Not retained by us. Provider logs expire on that provider's own schedule. We do not maintain user accounts, user profiles, analytics profiles, advertising identifiers, or server-side backups of your data. Because nothing is retained on our systems, there is nothing on our side to expire, archive, or delete.

You are in full control of every piece of data the App creates, and you can delete it at any time without contacting us: iOS: delete the App from your Home Screen or via Settings → General → iPhone Storage → Focus Timer Desk Clock → Delete App. Android: Settings → Apps → Focus Timer Desk Clock → Storage → Clear data (or uninstall the App). Inside the App: reset your timer and display preferences back to their defaults from the App's settings screen. Clearing the App's data or uninstalling the App permanently deletes all locally stored App data, including your entire focus session history and every statistic, report, and chart derived from it. This cannot be undone, and we cannot restore it for you because we never held a copy. If you ever have a question about deletion, or believe we hold data about you, email us at vincenttrandeveloper@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request". We respond within 30 days. Purchase and subscription records are held by Apple or Google and must be requested from them directly, under their own policies. If we ever introduce sync, accounts, or any other server-side feature, we will publish the specific retention periods for that data in this Policy and update the store Data safety disclosures before the feature is enabled.

Your device's own backup service may include the App's local data — and therefore your focus session history — in your device backup. On iOS this is iCloud Backup; on Android it is Google's Auto Backup for Apps. These backups are created and controlled by Apple or Google under your account and their privacy and retention policies, not ours: we never receive them and cannot read them. You can control this in your device settings — on iOS via Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage and on Android via Settings → Google → Backup — and a backup copy is removed when you delete the backup or turn the service off for the App.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, including relying on the operating system's app sandbox and storage protections on your device. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

Depending on laws in your country or state (for example GDPR in the EEA, CCPA/CPRA in California), you may have the right to: Access, correct, or delete personal information we control Restrict or object to certain processing Withdraw consent where processing is consent-based Lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority To exercise rights, contact us using Section 13. For data that exists only on your device, you can often delete it directly via OS settings or by uninstalling the App.

The App is not directed at children under 13 (or another minimum age under local law). We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you are a parent and believe your child has provided data, contact us so we can address it appropriately.

If you are outside the country where we operate, data may be processed in other countries (for example when using Apple, Google, or cloud providers). We use appropriate safeguards where required by law (for example standard contractual clauses).
We may update this Privacy Policy. A new effective date will appear at the top. For material changes, we may also notify you in the App or via the store where appropriate.
